## KultrDL 1.2.2

**A new logo:** a K whose stem ends in a download arrow, in blue on dark grey.

- The app icon is now drawn as a vector, so it's sharp on every screen. It fits round, squircle and rounded-square launcher shapes, and themed icons on Android 13 and later.
- The same logo is used inside the app, in notifications and on GitHub.

## Install

Download the APK for your phone below — **arm64-v8a** fits nearly every recent phone; **universal** fits all of them but is larger — and open it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your library. Requires Android 8.0 or later.
